name: Odysseus
introduce:
KX-098 奥德修斯
由卡玛达制造的中型机兵，与卡玛达已推出的重型机兵KX-075赫拉克勒斯属于同一系列。
奥德修斯继承了来自KX-075优秀的信息传感系统，以及卓越的钢岚合金框架。并根据修理机的定位做出了非常完善的优化。其搭载的动能监测仪能根据目标的机兵状态提供动能优化方案，使奥德修斯成为战场上实时运转的能源优化站。

20434.name: Kinetic Monitor
20434.SpecificEffects: After executing a single-target repair skill, if the target's HP is full, grants the target <buf ID=204312>[Kinetic Monitor]</buf>. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

30328.name: Inspiration Mod
30328.SpecificEffects:
When allies within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles have over <color=#F74848>50%</color> HP, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-12%</color>;
After performing active repairs, can trigger <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>. Cannot move before attacking. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.
